name: Performance deep-dive
what_happens: Joint call with merchant and Payments Ops to review success-rate drop by method/bank; share fix plan within 3 days.
when_it_applies: Success rate fell sharply or merchant complains of failures
steps: Joint technical call with merchant & Payments Ops within 24h
Audit gateway failure logs by payment method, issuer bank & UPI handle
Deploy 3-day dynamic downtime routing fix plan before any commercial discussion

name: Support recovery
what_happens: CSM takes ownership of all open tickets, gives a single point of contact and a closure date; senior callback within 48 hours.
steps: Assign single CSM point-of-contact ownership across all open tickets
Escalate unresolved settlement/webhook tickets to specialist engineering queue
Deliver senior callback within 48h with guaranteed closure timestamps

name: Commercial review
what_happens: Account Manager reviews rate card, volume tiers and renewal terms before the renewal date.
steps: Verify Tier-1 gateway performance and support queues are 100% clear
Benchmark current MDR against merchant’s recent monthly TPV run-rate
Present custom volume-tier rate card & fee-freeze proposal ahead of renewal cliff

name: Re-engagement and adoption
what_happens: Executive-sponsor outreach plus a short workshop on unused products and reports; re-confirm the right contact person.
when_it_applies: Low logins, few products used, no response to outreach
steps: Re-confirm operational POC & align with incoming executive sponsor
Audit reconciliation health and webhook/dashboard usage
Run 20-minute workshop on automated settlement & multi-product workflows

name: Growth / expansion check-in
what_happens: Positive check-in; offer new products or higher-limit plans.
steps: Congratulate merchant on strong 6-month TPV expansion trajectory
Review higher-tier transaction limits and API scaling tickets
Pitch Subscriptions, Route, or automated payout workflows

name: Monitor only
what_happens: No outreach; keep on watchlist and re-check next month.
when_it_applies: Seasonal dip, low-volume stable, or no real risk signal
steps: Keep on automated telemetry watchlist; consume zero human CSM hours
Re-evaluate trajectory on next monthly planning cycle
